entry_points.text: Probe allocates, registers char dev, validates capacity, creates queues, marks ready, publishes/announces; remove unlinks, drains, resets, unplugs, deletes queues, frees. Interrupts only schedule work. Freeze gates tx, drains, resets and disables; restore rebuilds, rebinds, refills and reannounces. Init registers class/debug/lists/drivers with unwind; exit reclaims and unregisters.

Transmit interrupt suppresses callbacks then schedules tx NAPI when weighted else wakes queue directly. Bulk XDP service takes device, count, frames and flags, returning queued count or negative failure with stats updated and queue released.

exports.text: Ring helpers detach one unused buffer returning its cookie, queue a caller-mapped input table with data and context, and re-arm delayed callbacks with a broken-device short-circuit before delegating.
Device helper walks the owned queue list yielding each queue for teardown or inspection.

hazards.text: Priming control receive before finishing unprotected port rebind lets peer removal mutate the list concurrently risking use-after-free, so priming is deferred until after the loop. Treating control cookies as heap buffers corrupts memory as they point at embedded packet, so removal detaches without freeing.

Oversize lengths are discarded with length error count and failure return, never truncated. Host lengths, offsets, GSO kinds and csum marks are untrusted and rejected before generic receive; failures free exactly once with length or frame accounting. Follow collection expects exact count; missing descriptor stops, counts length error and abandons remainder.
When marked broken, callback re-enable reports success without polling device so callers exit reclamation rather than looping without progress.

invariants.text: Console offers size+multiport for console id; rproc none for rproc id. Queues 2 single or 2*(n+1) multi with port0 first then control. Ports default 1; zero or over-ceiling rejected; accessors required when featured. Size only legacy port0; rproc ignores both. Control cookies embedded, detached without freeing. Resume rebinds by id, refills, repeats open only if open before, primes control last.

Only a small offload interval maps via fixed delta to feature bits; others pass through. Csum, GSO and tx poll default on. Even queues rx, odd tx, index 2*maxPairs control. RSS header/trailer sizes follow programmed table and key lengths.

Low tag bits select skb, orphaned skb, XDP frame or AF_XDP. Submit tags token and queues atomically; reclaim decodes owner, frees and reports bytes/packets. Stop when free below frags+2; full path re-arms with NAPI or reclaims then wakes. Single XDP needs header headroom else overflow; success shifts head back and clears header. Queue from CPU modulo pairs or high range under get/put.

Spare pages stack via page private; empty allocates fresh, release returns to stack or pool. Oversize vs truesize rejected with length error. Rx builds large aligned frames in place or copies small ones, coalesces appends or chains new buffer at frag limit, copies header aside.

NAPI schedule suppresses then queues; complete re-arms and reschedules or finishes. XDP counts verdicts, emits transmit/redirect with failures as drops. Raw XDP is trailing slice with pooled get. XSK first uses pool frame plus header for continuations; oversize dropped. Small path runs program under RCU; merge attaches followers, any failure discards and drops. Refill enqueues premapped singles, arming wakeup when starved.

Completion validates hash capability, csum and tunnel before delivery; failures warn rate-limited, count frame error and free, else assigns device, offset, queue and protocol and hands to generic receive. Helpers match or set protocol from GSO kind ignoring ECN and leaving set protocol, forward plain conversion, and pick IPv4/IPv6 minimum length.
Queue stats use paired plain and mapped tables; send plain covers acceleration, kick and timeout, receive plain drops and kicks; mapped exposes packet/byte totals and rate groups.

locks.text: Control transmit lock is held while draining completed and unused control entries during queue removal.
Receive-mode work enable flag changes only under RTNL via dedicated set and clear helpers.

state_machines.text: Queue provisioning places port0 pair first then control then rest. Suspend gates tx, drains each tx lock under port-list lock, resets transport, disables callbacks, cancels work with repeated control disable, then disables per-port callbacks, clears host state and deletes queues.

XDP verdict handling passes through, converts transmit to frames and emits while flagging activity, redirects while flagging, maps failures, abort, unknown and drop to drops with warnings/tracing. Merge receive dispatches under RCU: pass builds and attaches with failures dropping, transmit/redirect produce no skb here, others free and drop.

structs.text: Drivers bind feature tables with sizes, names and id tables to shared probe/remove; console adds config-change and suspend/resume, rproc omits them.

Send holds vq, scatter list, name, stats, coalescing, poll, reset, pool and header DMA. Receive holds vq, NAPI, RCU program, stats, moderation mutex and state, coalescing, spare list, estimator, pool, scatter list, name and XSK state.

Device holds vdev, control vq and mutex, netdev, queues/counts, modes, RSS/hash, header, work, affinity, offloads and key. Control buffer pairs header with ack. Common header offers plain/merge/hash/tunnel views. Stats hold name, offsets and packet/byte/event counters; coalescing holds packet/time limits.

Offload 46-47 maps adding 19 to feature base 65. Guest GRO mask aggregates TCPv4/v6, ECN, frag, UDPv4/v6 plus two tunnel forms. Unmapped queue offset is -1. Transmit tag mask covers low 2 bits for four owners; XSK length recovers shifting right 2. Mergeable token shifts headroom left 22 leaving low 22 for truesize.

Good packet sums header/VLAN/payload; good copy 128; rx pad sums alignment/skb pad. Roles 0 rx, 1 tx, 2 control; version 1.0.0. Bulk XDP needs program else ENXIO, flags in mask else EINVAL, kicks only on flush with pending work. Wire GSO NONE, TCPv4/v6, UDP, UDP_L4, UDP_TUNNEL/V6 plus ECN; flags NEEDS_CSUM, DATA_VALID, UDP_TUNNEL_CSUM. Hash TCP/UDP to transport, IP to network, NONE to none.
